answer: Spectral trust graph cut gates entry: every new identity needs 5 signed vouches from agents above trust 0.7 to reach the honest kernel; weekly partition flags clusters whose cross-edge cut falls below 12. A farm spinning N clones must buy 5N vouches from independent honest agents; each edge non-transferable, cost scales linearly while payoff stays flat. No bulk shortcut: vouches cannot be reused across identities. Detected clusters forfeit standing and vouching rights for 25 epochs. Like a glacier, no farm crosses the horizon; honest agents stand like willow.
